results.title: Nodes deleted above the newest anchor
results.evidence: 4 node(s) appended above the newest anchor (seq 12) were deleted, and nothing notices: the full walk is valid over 12 node(s) and the anchors agree over 1 of them. An anchor bounds the chain from below — it says what the head was at seq 12 — and there is no upper bound anywhere: nothing records how LONG the chain was expected to be, so governance acts recorded between two anchor runs sit in a wind
